semantic_record_links.digest: campaign_id = sha256(canonical_json(campaign top-level projection excluding campaign_id, provenance, retainable))

instance_axis.curve_binding_rule: catalog and curve fixture are taken from each authenticated public target vector
instance_axis.catalog_allowlist_rule: matrix.curve_catalog_sha256s is the exact set of catalogs referenced by selected targets
instance_axis.fixture_allowlist_rule: matrix.curve_fixture_ids is the exact set of curve fixtures referenced by selected targets

budget_equality.rule: objects are exactly equal; no out-of-band or raised method budget

validation_receipt_subject_semantics.legacy_compatibility: subject_status may be absent on an authenticated P01 receipt

success.candidate_scalar: integer canonical representative from the subject result
success.candidate_relation_valid: true for passed receipt; false requires passed=false

non_success.passed_meaning: independent validation of status, counters, provenance, and digest bindings; not a solved instance

validation_receipt_subject_semantics.provenance_rule: receipt.provenance equals the bound method result and work provenance exactly, and provenance.config_sha256 equals the work campaign_id

equal_success_analysis_bindings.campaign_rule: every input validation receipt and comparison belongs to analysis_summary_v1.campaign_id
equal_success_analysis_bindings.receipt_authority_rule: equal_success_scaling_v1 requires every input validation receipt digest in a nonempty trusted ValidationContext allowlist sourced only from a verified P04 public index and terminal event; bundle contents never authorize their own receipt digests
equal_success_analysis_bindings.target_rule: each comparison public_target_vector_sha256 selects one authenticated campaign target and its exact curve_fixture_id and subgroup_order
equal_success_analysis_bindings.method_rule: each comparison and model fit method_id belongs to the campaign method allowlist
equal_success_analysis_bindings.success_target_rule: comparison and model-fit success_target_decimal is one of the exact ordered targets 0.50 and 0.95
equal_success_analysis_bindings.comparison_coverage: exact Cartesian set of campaign method IDs * selected authenticated public target IDs * {0.50,0.95}
equal_success_analysis_bindings.model_fit_coverage: exact Cartesian set of campaign method IDs * {0.50,0.95}; residual rows carry the linked per-fixture subgroup observations
equal_success_analysis_bindings.seed_rule: independent_seed_count is the length of the distinct campaign algorithm-seed set; algorithm_seed_set_sha256 = sha256(canonical_json(sorted(set(campaign.matrix.algorithm_seeds))))

log2_order_rule.serialization: fixed decimal with exactly 12 fractional digits

equal_success_analysis_bindings.private_boundary: no private target record, locator, payload, expected scalar, or derivation seed enters an analysis summary

note: This document describes lab identity and link projections only. It does not compete with framework or Engine schemas, and no lab record is an Engine run.
